name: afya_voice_orchestrator
description: Google Cloud Agent Builder compatible orchestrator service for SihaLink.

tools.name: start_encounter
tools.description: Initialize an encounter session and start the orchestrator lifecycle.

tools.name: route_to_intake
tools.description: Send base64 audio to the Intake Agent for multilingual clinical extraction.

tools.name: route_to_geo
tools.description: Send extracted encounter and GPS coordinates to the Geo Agent for location enrichment.

tools.name: route_to_data
tools.description: Store a geo-enriched encounter in MongoDB via the Data Agent.

tools.name: request_human_decision
tools.description: Pause for CHV confirmation before sending a referral or alert.

tools.name: route_to_notify
tools.description: Send an alert/referral payload to the Notify Agent for Telegram delivery.

tools.name: trigger_surveillance
tools.description: Trigger an outbreak surveillance run or schedule the next detection cycle.

tools.name: queue_offline_encounter
tools.description: Store an encounter locally in the offline queue for later sync.

tools.name: process_offline_queue
tools.description: Process all queued offline encounters when connectivity returns.
